eventTypes.name: Private Online Lesson
eventTypes.description: A focused one-on-one lesson with game review, calculation work, and a clear training assignment.
eventTypes.bestFor: Students anywhere — online is the primary way Matt coaches, using Chess.com classroom with a shared board.

eventTypes.name: Private In-Person Lesson
eventTypes.description: Over-the-board coaching for students and families who want in-person feedback and practical training.
eventTypes.bestFor: Families in the greater Fredericksburg, Virginia area. Limited availability.

eventTypes.name: Student Fit Call
eventTypes.description: A short conversation about goals, rating, schedule, and whether coaching is the right fit.
eventTypes.bestFor: New families or adults who want to talk before booking a lesson.
